title: Xbox Mandates Four-Day Office Work For Certain Employees, Said To Affect 'Thousands'
summary:
"Taking advantage of that proximity...".

Last year, Microsoft announced to its employees that it expected them to start working at least three days in the office per-week, and now that requirement is going up to four days for certain Xbox employees as of February 2027.

This is according to a report from The Verge, which quotes Xbox's chief people officer (Jacinda Chislum Pearson) from a recent internal memo. In a nutshell, it sounds like anyone who lives within a short distance of Microsoft's campus in Redmond, Washington will be told to attend the office for four days or more per-week.

summary:

title: AMD FSR 4.1 Announced For Xbox Series X|S And ROG Xbox Handhelds
summary:
"And there's even more ahead with Project Helix...".

FSR (FidelityFX Super Resolution) 4.1 is AMD's impressive upscaling tech, which renders games at a lower resolution before using machine learning (ML)-powered gaming technology to improve visual fidelity and boost performance.
